title: nan
authors: Li Z.; Liu Y.; Zeng Q.; Liu J.; Li F.; Zhang G.
key_contribution: Presents a vision/map attitude matrix aided IMU/odometer integrated navigation method for urban road vehicles subject to GNSS blockage.
